name: mcp-price-tracker
description: Ask your AI what something costs right now, track price drops and get told when a target price is hit. All data stays local.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: price_check
tools.description: Fetch a product page right now and report its price, currency and title, plus the change against the last price stored for that URL. Does not create a watch.

tools.name: watch_add
tools.description: Start tracking a product page. Fetches it once and stores the first observation. Optionally set a target price to be alerted about.

tools.name: watch_list
tools.description: Show every tracked item with its current price, target and last check time.

tools.name: watch_remove
tools.description: Stop tracking an item, by watch id or by URL. Its history is deleted.

tools.name: watch_refresh
tools.description: Re-fetch one watch or every watch, append the new observations and show current, previous, min, max, change % and target hits.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: List the stored observations for one watch, newest last. Free shows the last 10.

tools.name: price_add_manual
tools.description: Store a price you read yourself, for shops that block automated requests. Creates the watch if it does not exist yet.

tools.name: alerts_pending
tools.description: Show watches whose latest price is at or below the target, or which dropped 5% or more against the previous observation.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
